image_01_direction: Editar somente poses da referência original: Max ajoelhado, Pixie agachada segurando bomba baixa, Brute em pé com shotgun horizontal. Preservar cabeças, rostos e expressões originais. Max sem raiva. Kai com mãos reais no bolso e mãos de energia separadas; Capy com três apoios e um tentáculo armado; skatista em nova manobra.

image_02_to_04_prompts.name: 02-lateral
image_02_to_04_prompts.prompt:
Make ONE landscape alternate-pose RIFT JUMPERS poster. The user's most recently ATTACHED ORIGINAL is the authoritative reference. The other recent image is a pose study; keep the USER ORIGINAL's drawing style and face designs. Change poses only. Exactly same six characters and original costumes, colors, stylized proportions, angular black outlines, flat cel shadows, sparse halftone, white radial background, cyan/magenta shards and upper center RIFT JUMPERS logo. Max, Brute and Pixie dominant foreground. Their HEADS should look like direct reuse of original heads: preserve same head angles and face features. Max: orange spiky hair, BACKWARDS navy cap, simple solid black angular eyes, original calm focused expression, high scarf covering mouth, navy jacket/white shirt. NO ANGER or rage and no added facial detail. Pixie: cute child, pink hair, black skull hat, exact original simple black wedge eyes and one white mischievous grin, retain child proportions and recognizable outfit motifs; covered black top, pink skirt/shorts over black opaque shorts, no sexualization. Brute: large BLUE ORGANIC BARE-CHESTED creature, blue skin NOT armor, original mask, orange trousers, skull belt, shotgun.
Kai in rear: white hair, black high collar coat, BOTH REAL HANDS IN POCKETS, separate purple/lilac ghost hands control levitating sniper well away from his body. Purple-haired skater rear with cyan visor/headphones, white top, black baggy pants, cyan skateboard and floating speakers. Capy rear: capybara in compact white/green pod, exactly FOUR articulated Doc Octopus tentacles: THREE ground supports for movement, ONE holds gun. No extra tentacles. Clear silhouettes, readable original faces. No extra characters, glossy rendering, irises, detailed teeth, or face redesign.
Different body poses: MAX left foreground in wide standing sideways stance with pistol raised BESIDE shoulder pointing upwards, original composed head and scarf. PIXIE right foreground leans forward playfully mid-step carrying skull bomb low with both hands, original head angle. BRUTE center foreground kneels on one knee, shotgun pointing toward left at waist height. KAI rear left standing with weight on opposite leg, hands pocketed, floating sniper low off to his side. SKATER rear right in board nose-grab jump with tucked knees. CAPY rear far right in wide low tripod stance, fourth gun arm reaching left. Maintain original faces and graphic style exactly.
